investment_strategy: Build a concentrated but diversified AI-focused equity portfolio tilted toward mega-cap platform leaders and critical infrastructure providers, with secondary exposure to enterprise software and defense AI, while avoiding structurally weak or overly speculative names. Given elevated volatility (VIX ~24.6) and relatively high rates (10Y ~4.23%), the strategy emphasizes companies with strong fundamentals, consistent earnings beats, positive analyst consensus, and manageable volatility. The goal is to capture long-term AI and digital transformation upside with a moderate overall risk profile by overweighting lower-volatility, high-quality compounders (MSFT, GOOGL, AAPL) and selected high-growth infrastructure (NVDA, AVGO, MU), complemented by enterprise and defense AI enablers (AMZN, ORCL, IBM, META, PLTR). Position sizes are adjusted downward for higher volatility and/or concentrated geopolitical or regulatory risk.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Core of the AI boom via OpenAI partnership, leading cloud platform, central in regulatory and infrastructure discussions, with diversified AI monetization channels.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Anchor position due to best-in-class fundamentals, strong buy consensus, diversified AI exposure, and only moderate volatility; sized largest in portfolio to stabilize higher-beta holdings.
